core.name: search_docs
core.description: Search Terragrunt documentation for HCL blocks, CLI commands, functions, and IaC patterns. Modes: search, list sections, get section content, or find code examples.

mode.description: search: full-text query | list: browse sections | section: get content by name | examples: code samples

detailLevel.description: Section and examples modes only: summary for an overview, full for complete content or code (ignored in search mode)

limit.description: Maximum examples to return in examples mode

advanced.description: Use curated advanced examples instead of docs code blocks

category.description: With advanced=true, only examples from this category

listCategories.description: List curated example categories instead of examples

core.name: function_reference
core.description: Get Terragrunt built-in function details (find_in_parent_folders, dependency, read_terragrunt_config, etc.) or list all available functions by category.

mode.description: summary: signature and short text | full: complete details

include_examples.description: Include usage examples in the result

category.description: Only list functions in this category

search.description: Text to match when listing functions

core.name: cli_reference
core.description: Get current Terragrunt CLI command help (run --all, browse, plan, apply, hcl validate, etc.) or list commands by category.

command.description: Command to get help for, e.g. "run --all"

category.description: Only list commands in this category

search.description: Text to match when listing commands

core.name: get_hcl_config_reference
core.description: Get current Terragrunt HCL block and attribute documentation with syntax and examples, including stacks, feature flags, exclusions, error handling, catalogs, and engines.

category.description: Only list blocks in this category

listBlocks.description: List all block names instead of one reference

config.name: get_hcl_config_reference
config.description: Get current Terragrunt HCL block and attribute documentation with syntax and examples, including stacks, feature flags, exclusions, error handling, catalogs, and engines.

category.description: Only list blocks in this category

listBlocks.description: List all block names instead of one reference

config.name: build_config
config.description: Generate or write Terragrunt HCL configuration files (terragrunt.hcl). Use cases: remote_state backends (S3, GCS, Azure), provider generation, dependency blocks, hooks, inputs, and cicd (CI/CD-ready config for GitHub Actions, GitLab, Azure DevOps).

useCase.description: remote_state | provider_generation | dependencies | hooks | inputs | cicd (omit to write existing content)

backend.description: For remote_state, the backend type (s3, azurerm, gcs). For cicd, the platform (github-actions, gitlab, azure-devops).

tier.description: essential: basics | advanced: common extras | complete: every attribute

strictValidation.description: Validate with the Terragrunt CLI when installed and fail if invalid

write.description: Write to path instead of only returning the config

path.description: Target .hcl file inside an allowed directory

overwrite.description: Replace an existing file at path

createBackup.description: Back up an existing file before overwriting

createParentDirs.description: Create missing parent directories of path

preview.description: Dry-run: never write; return what would be written plus a diff and overwrite/backup info

compareWith.description: Path of an existing file to diff the result against (defaults to path in preview mode)

guidance.name: get_guidance
guidance.description: Get Terragrunt best practices, block comparisons (dependency vs dependencies), DRY patterns, or experiment status (type=experiments lists active/completed experiments and how to enable them) for infrastructure-as-code organization.

type.description: best-practices | comparison (e.g. dependency vs dependencies) | pattern | experiments

mode.description: summary: key points | full: complete guidance with examples

listAll.description: List all topics, comparisons and patterns instead of answering a query

guidance.name: diagnose_terragrunt_error
guidance.description: Diagnose Terragrunt and Terraform error messages with root cause analysis and solutions. Handles dependency cycles, state lock errors, provider issues, and HCL syntax problems.

error_message.description: Full error text from the failed command, e.g. "Error acquiring the state lock"

command.description: Command that failed, e.g. "terragrunt run --all apply"

enableFuzzyMatching.description: Also match errors similar to known patterns

detailLevel.description: summary: matches with causes and solutions | full: adds debugging steps, related errors, and documentation links

enrichWithDocs.description: Full detail only: add documentation-sourced solutions and links (on by default in full; true selects full detail when detailLevel is unset)
